posts.title: The Most Stupid Way to Learn English
posts.description: Learning a new language takes time but it doesn't have to take such an indefinite time as it did for me. Read about my journey to avoid my mistakes.

posts.title: Book Review: Dear Data
posts.description: It all began with an experiment between two artists in information design. posts.title: Book Review: First You Write a Sentence.: The Elements of Reading, Writing ... and Life.
posts.description: I think it's the kind of book that is best appreciated if you have no expectations of it. The book is really excellent but you will probably not find what you expect. If you are looking for specific rules to follow for writing better sentences, you'll be disappointed. The book is about developing the intuition to know what makes a good sentence.
